name: ryu.laya
description: Run Convai Innovations' Apache-2.0 Laya decision models locally through authenticated Ryu tools and as a selectable Shadow computer-use planner. Laya classifies text, email, tickets, and JSON into typed choice, score, and boolean answers; it does not generate text. The plugin provisions its Python sidecar and all three pinned Hugging Face checkpoints (about 2.37 GB / 2.21 GiB) inside the plugin runtime.
